0.why: the manual page at tsugumasa320.github.io/Ambivalent-Instruments-Manual says this jack multiplies the knob frequency by two raised to the voltage, so 0V leaves the knob pitch unchanged. No source is published, so the scaling rests on the manual alone

comment: No source is published. What is above comes from the maker's manual, the panel artwork and the module's own port and parameter names. Index order is not panel order anywhere on this module: the five trims are params 8 to 12 scattered beside the knobs they belong to, and the bottom jack row is inputs 1, 3, 2, 4 and 6 reading across. The 20Hz to 2000Hz oscillator range, the 20Hz to 20000Hz cutoff range, the 0.5 to 12 resonance range, the 10000 gain ceiling and the volume ceiling of 2 are fixed in the module; the default pitch of 261.625565Hz that the manual quotes is not, and is not repeated in a line. The manual says Freq CV Trim defaults to 1 while the other four trims default to 0.
